instruction: Refer to gui_002_flange_blank.step in SolidWorks, a circular flange blank centered at the origin with outside diameter 100 mm, thickness 12 mm, and the flange axis along Z. For this task, open SOLIDWORKS 2025 from its desktop shortcut, then load `gui_002_flange_blank.step`. Cut one through center bore of diameter 40 mm on the Z axis, centered at X=0 and Y=0. Add six equally spaced through bolt holes of diameter 7 mm on a bolt circle radius of 35 mm, with the first hole on +X. Add 1.5 mm fillets to the upper and lower outside circular edges. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_002_flange_out.step as one part in millimeters with the center at the origin.

command: import pyautogui, time; time.sleep(20); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(5)
